instruction: Download the last Wednesday's weekly work meeting slides and recording from Gmail and save them in my file system as per the existing file structure and format.
notes: Current date 2023-05-19 (Fri) so last Wednesday is 2023-05-17. The plan logs into gmail and file_system, inspects the existing file tree (recursive show_directory) to learn where/how previous weekly-meeting slides and recordings are stored (structure-known gates downloads so paths follow the existing pattern), finds the meeting thread via show_inbox_threads with a query, reads attachment ids via show_thread, then calls gmail.download_attachment twice with download_to_file_path targets. download_attachment creates the needed directory, so no explicit create_directory is modeled; no files are updated/deleted and no attachments are deleted, matching the evaluation. supervisor-complete-task takes the two attachment/path records as non-API parameters so its precondition equals the goal conjunction; the task asks no question so no answer is passed. Static facts (username-for, token-for, matches-query, attached-to, target-path) tie runtime objects to the apps/entities they belong to.
